body:
## Objective
Resolve #637 and #635 by aligning `packages/fleet/README.md` and `packages/fleet/bin/fleet.mjs` USAGE with the shipped binary name, registered adapter list, exit-code contract, and Linux sandbox backend requirement.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `packages/fleet/README.md` lists all 9 registered adapters (`claude-code`, `codex`, `agy`, `gemini`, `jetski`, `copilot`, `opencode`, `pi`, `cursor`) matching `ADAPTERS`, documents `adlc-fleet` (and `adlc fleet`) in Usage, documents quarantine (`quarantined`) and PR-open failure (`pr-open-failed`) under exit code 2, and removes `/unshare` from the Linux sandbox prerequisite (specifying `bwrap` / `bubblewrap` on Linux) — verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/fleet-entry.test.mjs`
2. `packages/fleet/bin/fleet.mjs` `USAGE` spells commands as `adlc-fleet run`, `adlc-fleet status`, and `adlc-fleet unlock` (noting `or: adlc fleet ...`) — verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/fleet-entry.test.mjs`
title: fleet: document all 9 adapters, adlc-fleet binary, exit 2 causes, and bwrap-only Linux backend (#637, #635)
